narrative.title: Peak Draw on the Solar String
narrative.scenario: A solar farm streams one ampere reading per panel into a rolling buffer each minute. The hardware team needs the single highest reading the string ever produced so they can size the inline fuse. Return that peak value.
narrative.inputFormat: An integer n followed by an array A of n integer readings.
narrative.outputFormat: A single integer: the maximum element of A.

testCases.explanation: Scanning the five readings, 90 is the highest value encountered.
The peak sits at the end of the buffer, so the scan cannot stop early.

hintLevels: Level 1: You only need one number, so think about which single value must be remembered while walking the buffer.
Level 2: Seed a running best with the very first reading, then advance one index at a time and overwrite the best whenever a larger reading shows up.
Level 3: Watch the seed choice: starting at 0 breaks the moment every reading is negative, and a single-element array must return that element untouched.
